timing_scope.degree_of_regularity: first zero graded component of homogeneous highest-degree input-part ideal; final basis maximum degree is reported separately; solving degree is unavailable
timing_scope.fixture_generation_status: unmeasured; no generation-inclusive total pipeline time is claimed
timing_scope.measurement_mode: prebuilt-fixture solving; fixture generation is not measured
timing_scope.observed_subprocess_wall_seconds: process launch through completion or forced kill; includes import/startup and diagnostic, excludes parent input serialization and fixture generation
timing_scope.root_extraction: evaluate computed Groebner basis over finite allowed domain; independent truth enumeration is never consumed as solver roots
timing_scope.suite_wall_seconds: iteration over prebuilt cases including input serialization and subprocess orchestration; excludes fixture generation and loading the suite JSON
timing_scope.total_solve_seconds: worker normalization and parsing of prebuilt polynomial equations + polynomial setup + Groebner basis + evaluation of computed basis over declared finite domain + selected-subgroup checks and signed point relation verification; fixture generation, Semaev construction/Weil descent, factor-base and target construction, golden-truth enumeration, SymPy import, process startup, input JSON serialization, and degree-regularity diagnostic excluded
